en.name: Skyr
en.summary: Skyr is Icelandic cultured skim milk strained until it is about three times the protein of yoghurt — technically a fresh cheese, though it behaves like yoghurt in every way that matters here. Sealed, 1–2 weeks in the fridge; opened, 5–7 days; frozen, 1–2 months.
en.pantry: Skyr is a fresh cultured dairy product and cannot be kept at room temperature. Its low pH holds most bacteria off but that is not a licence to leave it out: follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if the room is above 32 °C (90 °F). For a lunch box, pack it with an ice pack. Take out only the portion you are eating rather than letting the tub warm up on the table.
en.fridge: Sealed, skyr keeps 1–2 weeks at 0–5 °C, or to the printed date if that comes first. Once opened, use it within 5–7 days: keep the lid on and use a clean spoon, because the acidity holds bacteria off but not mould. Weeping whey on the surface is normal and can be stirred back in or poured off. The numbers here are borrowed from what is published for yoghurt and cross-checked against the more conservative published yoghurt line, which is what the opened figure follows — no agency publishes a skyr timeline.
en.freezer: Skyr freezes for 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F), with the same caveat as yoghurt: it goes grainy on thawing, because the strained protein network cannot hold the water back once ice crystals have been through it. That is fine stirred into a smoothie, a batter or a marinade, and wrong for eating with a spoon. Freeze it in its sealed pot or in small containers with a little headspace, and label the date.
en.thawing: Thaw skyr in the fridge, never on the counter, stir it well and use it within a couple of days. Do not refreeze it.
spoilage: Mould of any colour on the surface or under the lid.
A yeasty, fizzy or bitter taste beyond the usual clean sourness.
A bulging lid, or bubbles rising through the pot.
A ropy or slimy texture, or a pink or grey cast.
tips: Buy single pots if you eat it occasionally; large tubs run a short clock once opened.
Clean spoon every time, and never eat straight from a tub you are keeping.
Stir the whey back in for a softer texture, or pour it off for a thicker one.
Freeze it in cubes for smoothies rather than trying to keep a half tub too long.

faq.q: How long does skyr keep in the fridge?
faq.a: About 1–2 weeks sealed at 0–5 °C, or to the printed date, and 5–7 days once opened.
Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C. It thaws grainy, so use it in smoothies, baking or marinades rather than eating it with a spoon.

faq.q: Is skyr a yoghurt or a cheese?
faq.a: Traditionally it is set with rennet as well as a culture, which makes it legally a cheese in Iceland. For storage it behaves like yoghurt.

faq.q: Is the liquid on top of skyr normal?
faq.a: Yes, that is whey. Stir it in or pour it off. Mould, fizz or bitterness is a different matter and means the pot goes.

zh.name: 冰島優格
zh.summary: Skyr 是冰島用脫脂乳發酵後重度瀝乾的產品，蛋白質大約是一般優格的三倍，嚴格說是一種新鮮乳酪，但在保存上表現得就像優格。未開封冷藏 1～2 週；開封後 5～7 天；冷凍 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: Skyr 是生鮮發酵乳製品，不能放室溫。它的低 pH 值確實能壓住大部分細菌，但那不代表可以放在外面：請守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。帶便當請搭配保冷劑。要吃多少舀多少，不要讓整盒在餐桌上回溫。
zh.fridge: 未開封在 0～5 °C 下可放 1～2 週，或以包裝日期為準（取先到者）。開封後請在 5～7 天內吃完：蓋子蓋好、用乾淨的湯匙，因為酸度擋得住細菌但擋不住霉。表面滲出乳清是正常的，攪回去或倒掉都可以。這裡的數字借自優格的公告值，並與另一條較保守的優格公告說法交叉比對，開封後的數字採用的就是那條較保守的——沒有任何機構公告過 skyr 的期限。
zh.freezer: Skyr 在 −18 °C 下可放 1～2 個月，注意事項和優格一樣：解凍後質地會變粗，因為冰晶穿過之後，瀝乾的蛋白質網絡再也抓不住水分。這種狀態拌進果昔、麵糊或醃料完全沒問題，但不適合用湯匙直接吃。連密封杯一起冷凍，或分裝小盒並留一點空間，寫上日期。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫，攪拌均勻後一兩天內吃完。不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 表面或蓋內出現任何顏色的霉。
吃起來有酵母味、氣泡感或苦味，超出原本乾淨的酸味。
質地牽絲黏滑，或泛粉紅、泛灰。
tips: 偶爾才吃的話買小杯；大盒開封後時鐘走得很快。
每次都用乾淨的湯匙，要留的那盒不要挖著吃。
想要柔順就把乳清攪回去，想要更濃稠就倒掉。
與其硬留半盒，不如做成冰磚給果昔用。

faq.q: 冰島優格冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封在 0～5 °C 下約 1～2 週或以包裝日期為準；開封後 5～7 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月。解凍後質地變粗，適合打果昔、烘焙或做醃料。
傳統做法除了乳酸菌還會加凝乳酶，所以在冰島法規上算乳酪。但就保存而言，它的表現和優格一樣。

faq.q: skyr 上面那層水正常嗎？
faq.a: 正常，那是乳清，攪回去或倒掉都行。長霉、冒泡或發苦則不正常，整杯要丟。
